_comment: Single source of truth for the App Store Connect product catalogue.
1. tool/check_store_products.cjs — queries the App Store Connect API and
fails if any ID is missing or stuck in MISSING_METADATA.
still matches this list, so the two can never drift apart silently.
iOS subscription IDs are the canonical ID prefixed with 'subscription_'
(see lib/core/constants/product_catalog.dart). Coin packs use raw IDs.
A typo here is invisible in code review and fails only at runtime — which
is exactly how submission b9c4cdc6 was rejected under Guideline 2.1(b).
